title: Trump prepared to ease sanctions and release frozen funds for nuclear progress - report
description: Perhaps diplomacy isn't dead. Al Jazeera reports that diplomacy is continuing, citing a US official, and that Trump is prepared to ease sanctions and release frozen funds for progress on the nuclear issue. There isn't much detail on the report but it's starting to get a wider viewing and it's moving markets. The report also says the US is continuing 'positive' discussions and adds that Iran is 'flexible' on nuclear but that they're far apart on who takes the first steps. title: Trump set to speak in the Oval Office
description: Trump will make an announcement in the Oval Office today. The scheduled time is 2 pm ET but White House events never happen on time. The topic is a $15 billion steel mill in Iowa but reporters will be there and will surely ask him about Iran. In all likelihood he will have the usual rhetoric but it's something to keep an eye on. WTI was last up 18-cents to $92.59 after rising as high as $96.54 earlier. This article was written by Adam Button at investinglive.com.

title: China industrial profits rise 4.2% in August, weakest monthly gain this year
description: The slowdown in August puts the focus back on how much support Beijing will offer to protect corporate earnings, and economists quoted in the reports expect it to lean harder on stimulus. Any move would matter for Chinese and broader Asian equities, particularly industrial and materials names exposed to weak domestic demand. The persistent rise in energy costs cited in the reports is a further squeeze on margins for energy-intensive manufacturers, and it links the profit picture to crude oil.
